# KTX2 fixtures

All images are procedural ArkGlide test assets, generated by `scripts/create-ktx2-fixtures.mjs`; no third-party artwork is included. Colors are asymmetric quadrants; masks have checkerboard alpha; normal/detail gradients exercise tangent direction and channel packing (detail: R diffuse, G normal Y, B roughness, A normal X).

Checked-in ETC1S and UASTC/Zstd files were generated by the `basisu` binary distributed with npm `basisu@1.16.3` (its own banner reports **Basis Universal 1.15**). To regenerate everything:

```sh
node scripts/create-ktx2-fixtures.mjs /path/to/basisu
```

Without an encoder argument, only PNG and uncompressed RGBA8 fixtures are regenerated. Tests use the committed files and need no encoder, external assets or network. `normal`, `normal-tilt` and `detail` use linear transfer; color and mask files use sRGB. 64×64 Basis fixtures contain complete seven-level mip chains; the 30×18 NPOT UASTC file has five levels. RGBA8 fixtures contain one level, including that NPOT image and a mirrored `lu` orientation image. Runtime transcoder notices are shipped in `public/lib/ktx2/`.
